Francisco contributed to the Smart Data Research UK panel *"Let's do good things with data"* at the Royal Statistical Society International Conference 2025, held at the Edinburgh International Conference Centre (EICC), The Exchange, Edinburgh, Scotland, on 2 September 2025.

This panel contribution focused on doing socially impactful work with data, highlighting opportunities, challenges, and practical pathways for using data for public good.

The session discussed how data-driven research can support socially meaningful outcomes when paired with strong methodological standards, thoughtful governance, and a clear focus on public value. It also reflected on the role of collaborative initiatives such as Smart Data Research UK in creating pathways for responsible and effective data use.
